An '''armor regiment''' or '''line armor regiment''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Armor regiments were comprised of two [[armor battalion]]s, two [[repulsorlift battalion]]s, and a [[regimental headquarters]] for a total strength of 3,994 personnel, 304 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 106 heavy [[Tank/Legends|tanks]]. Armor regiments were never deployed on their own, and had more massed firepower than any other regimental-strength unit. With no [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] units, armor regiments could not be deployed to take and hold ground, and were only deployed as part of a [[Battle group|battlegroup]].<ref name="ISB" />

Armor regiments could be augmented by the addition of two more armor battalions, a repulsorlift battalion, and an [[assault battalion]].<ref name="ISB2" />
